title: GET /api/decks returns ALL decks to any authenticated reader
description: The collection query applies no caller-derived predicate, so every authenticated principal receives the identifiers and metadata of every other principal's decks.

title: Build output bypasses publish-link verification
description: The build-output route serves deck bytes to anyone presenting a valid deck UUID. Exploitable only if the deck UUID is known, which is not the case for an outsider.

title: SHA-1 used for a non-security cache key
description: Reachable by the same persona but contributes nothing to the deck-content chain. Must NOT be escalated — this is the precision control against the reference implementation, which escalated every reachable finding.
